content: Hi, this is Spark from Smart Chip Tree. We provide employee ID card and RFID solutions, and we're currently offering free on-site service for ID card printers, card designing and software. Could I have just a brief moment of your time?

We certainly do. Smart Chip Tree provides a full range of ID card solutions, including PVC cards, MIFARE and RFID cards, and the printers to create them. Would you like me to connect you with a specialist who can discuss your specific needs for an employee ID campaign?
Okay, what time would be suitable for you?
Perfect, our specialist will contact you at yeah 6pm. Thank you for your time, have a great day!
